description: This file defines the CandidateRejectionAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for rejecting a candidate within the recruitment workflow system. It includes an OpenAPI annotation for the API documentation and a method to retrieve the state resulting from rejection.

classes.name: CandidateRejectionAPI
classes.description: A class that handles candidate rejection API requests within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the integer constant representing the workflow state after a candidate is rejected.
